SELECT MAX(R.CX_BATCH_NO) CX_BATCH_NO, /*成型批次号*/ R.schedule_DATE, /*排产日期*/ CI.ARTICLE_CROWN_SPEC BIG_ROLL_CODE, /*钢带规格*/ CI.BELT_CODE1 STEEL_STRIP_CODE1, /*1#钢带代号*/ CI.BELT_CODE2 STEEL_STRIP_CODE2, /*2#钢带代号*/ REGEXP_SUBSTR(BELT_CUTTING_ANGLE, '[0-9]+') CUTTING_ANGLE, /*钢带裁断角度*/ TRUNC(MAX(CI.BELT_CRAFT1)) CRAFT1, /*1#钢带工艺*/ TRUNC(MAX(CI.BELT_CRAFT2)) CRAFT2, /*2#钢带工艺*/ MAX(CI.BELT_SIDE_RUBBER1) EDGE_GLUE, /*半钢边胶*/
SUM((nvl(R.CLASS1_PLAN_QTY, 0) + nvl(R.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY, 0)) * nvl(CI.FIT_DRUM_PERIMETER, 0) / 1000) DAY_PLAN_QTY1, /*1#钢带中班计划量，换算成米*/ SUM((nvl(R.CLASS3_PLAN_QTY, 0) + nvl(R.CLASS4_PLAN_QTY, 0)) * nvl(CI.FIT_DRUM_PERIMETER, 0) / 1000) NIGHT_PLAN_QTY1, /*1#钢带夜班计划量*/ NVL(ROUND(AVG(CI.FIT_DRUM_PERIMETER), 3), 0) UNIT_CONSUME1, /*单耗*/ NVL(CEIL(SUM(R.CLASS1_PLAN_QTY * CI.FIT_DRUM_PERIMETER / 1000)), 0) CX_CLASS1_PLAN, /*1#钢带对应成型一班的计划量，向上取整*/ NVL(CEIL(SUM(R.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY * CI.FIT_DRUM_PERIMETER / 1000)), 0) CX_CLASS2_PLAN, /*1#钢带对应成型二班的计划量，向上取整*/ NVL(CEIL(SUM(R.CLASS3_PLAN_QTY * CI.FIT_DRUM_PERIMETER / 1000)), 0) CX_CLASS3_PLAN, /*1#钢带对应成型三班的计划量，向上取整*/ NVL(CEIL(SUM(R.CLASS4_PLAN_QTY * CI.FIT_DRUM_PERIMETER / 1000)), 0) CX_CLASS4_PLAN, /*1#钢带对应成型次一班的计划量，向上取整*/ NVL(CEIL(SUM(R.CLASS5_PLAN_QTY * CI.FIT_DRUM_PERIMETER / 1000)), 0) CX_CLASS5_PLAN /*1#钢带对应成型次二班的计划量，向上取整*/ FROM T_CX_schedule_RESULT R LEFT JOIN T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO CI ON R.EMBRYO_CODE = CI.EMBRYO_CODE AND R.BOM_DATA_VERSION = CI.EMBRYO_VERSION WHERE R.schedule_DATE = #{scheduleDate} AND R.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND CI.DEL_FLAG = '0'
/* 仅对投产阶段的规格排产 */ AND CI.PRODUCTION_STAGE = '0'
GROUP BY R.schedule_DATE, CI.ARTICLE_CROWN_SPEC, CI.BELT_CODE1, CI.BELT_CODE2, REGEXP_SUBSTR(BELT_CUTTING_ANGLE, '[0-9]+')
HAVING SUM((NVL(R.CLASS1_PLAN_QTY, 0) + NVL(R.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY, 0) + NVL(R.CLASS3_PLAN_QTY, 0) + NVL(R.CLASS4_PLAN_QTY, 0) + NVL(R.CLASS5_PLAN_QTY, 0)) * CI.FIT_DRUM_PERIMETER) != 0

SELECT R.EMBRYO_CODE, R.BOM_DATA_VERSION EMBRYO_VERSION, CI.FIT_DRUM_PERIMETER, CI.ARTICLE_CROWN_SPEC, CI.BELT_CUTTING_ANGLE, CI.BELT_CODE1, CI.BELT_CODE2, CI.ID, CI.PRODUCTION_STAGE FROM T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT R LEFT JOIN T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO CI ON R.EMBRYO_CODE = CI.EMBRYO_CODE AND R.BOM_DATA_VERSION = CI.EMBRYO_VERSION AND CI.DEL_FLAG = '0' WHERE R.schedule_DATE = #{scheduleDate} AND R.DEL_FLAG = '0'
select param_code, param_value from T_CD15_PARAMS where DEL_FLAG = '0'
SELECT MAX(BATCH_NO) BATCH_NO FROM t_cd15_auto_schedule_record WHERE schedule_date = #{scheduleDate} AND del_flag = '0'

OR R.ID IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY CI.FIT_DRUM_PERIMETER, CI.ARTICLE_CROWN_SPEC, CI.BELT_CUTTING_ANGLE, CI.BELT_CODE1, CI.BELT_CODE2
